rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 88, Line 1: "If you received a refund, credit, or offset of state or local income taxes in 2025, you may be required to report this amount", and the TIP: "None of your refund is taxable if, in the year you paid the tax, you either (a) didn't itemize deductions, or (b) elected to deduct state and local general sales taxes". With no refund received, line 1 is zero and the refund worksheet and its screens are not needed; the project guards on refund.has (refund.received above zero). The candidate copies refund.taxable and declares the refund screens (refund.not_2024, refund.box8, refund.exc_tax, refund.exc_who) without that guard on every return, so it needs worksheet answers from filers with no refund. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s1.deepseek.json): 944 of 2,210 agree; all 1,266 differences are candidate-unknown on returns without a refund (classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek recorded, project $0.00, candidate stopping on refund.not_2024). No value differences. i1040gi p. 88 was not among the pages given (pp. 89–95, 98, 99, 104, 108), but Schedule 1 line 1 and the published refund.has (refund received above zero) state the condition, so this is not an interface gap. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 93, Line 16: "If you were self-employed or a partner, you may be able to take this deduction". Partnership and other Schedule E or K-1 income is refused by scope.schedule1, so within scope only a person with a Schedule C can have the deduction; the project asks person.plan only then (person.s16, guarded by person.has_sc). The candidate sums person.plan_deduction for every person, asking plan questions of people with no self-employment income and reaching the SEP and SIMPLE excess screens for them. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s1.deepseek.json): 1,066 of 2,210 agree; 960 candidate-unknown records stop on person.plan for a person without a Schedule C (classm.f2441.1.deepseek: person[taxpayer].plan; classm.f2441.2.deepseek: person[spouse].plan); 184 candidate-refuses are sep_excess or simple_excess screens on such a person (classm.f5695.5: spouse without a Schedule C, project $1,449.00 from the taxpayer's plan; classm.f8889.2.deepseek, classm.oi8z.1, classm.retirement.3). No value differences. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 95, Line 19a: "You can't take a deduction for alimony payments you made to or for your spouse if you entered into your divorce or separation agreement after December 31, 2018". The project asks s1.alimony (alimony under a pre-2019 agreement, or a recapture) and only then the amount and the s1.alimony_unsupported screen (amb.2025.alimony_screen). The candidate copies s1.alimony_paid and declares the screen on every return, so it needs the amount and the screen from filers with no pre-2019 alimony, answers the text does not need. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s1.deepseek.json): 903 of 2,210 agree; 1,290 candidate-unknown records stop on s1.alimony_unsupported (classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek recorded, project $0.00); 17 project-unknown are partial records withholding s1.alimony, which every interview asks because the project's line reads it first (bases classm.f8889.2.deepseek, classm.f5695.3, classm.s1.3, classm.sli.2). No value differences. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 89, Line 2a: "Alimony received is not included in your income if you entered into a divorce or separation agreement after December 31, 2018". The project asks s1.alimony (alimony under a pre-2019 agreement, or a recapture) and only then the amount and the s1.alimony_unsupported screen (amb.2025.alimony_screen). The candidate copies s1.alimony_received and declares the screen on every return, so it needs the amount and the screen from filers with no pre-2019 alimony, answers the text does not need. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s1.deepseek.json): 903 of 2,210 agree; 1,290 candidate-unknown records stop on s1.alimony_unsupported (classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek recorded, project $0.00); 17 project-unknown are partial records withholding s1.alimony, which every interview asks because the project's line reads it first (bases classm.f8889.2.deepseek, classm.f5695.3, classm.s1.3, classm.sli.2). No value differences. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 89, Line 7: "You should receive a Form 1099-G showing in box 1 the total unemployment compensation paid to you in 2025. Report this amount on line 7", reduced only by program contributions and 2025 overpayments repaid. With no compensation paid in 2025, line 7 is zero and s1.uc_unsupported (contributions, or repayment of an earlier year's compensation) is not needed for it: a repayment over $3,000 of earlier-year compensation is an itemized deduction or a Schedule 3 line 13b credit (p525 p. 36, Repayments; i1040gi p. 117, Line 13b), screened by sa.unsupported and scope.credits, not a line 7 amount. The project asks the screen only when s1.uc_paid is positive; the candidate declares it on every return. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s1.deepseek.json): 1,213 of 2,210 agree; 929 candidate-unknown records have no compensation and no screen answer (classm.f2441.1.deepseek and others, project $0.00); 68 candidate-refuses answer the screen yes with no 2025 compensation (classm.carloan.1: s1.uc_paid $0.00, s1.uc_unsupported true; classm.f5695.5, classm.otjob.3, classm.s1.3). No value differences. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 91, Line 8c: "Enter any canceled debt. Canceled debt may be shown in box 2 of Form 1099-C. However, part or all of your income from cancellation of debt may be nontaxable. See Pub. 4681". With no canceled debt, line 8c is zero and the exception and exclusion screen is not needed; the project asks s1.cod_unsupported only when s1.cod_any is true and the amount is positive (amb.2025.cod_fully_taxable). The candidate copies s1.cod_amount with no s1.cod_any guard and declares s1.cod_unsupported on every return. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s1.deepseek.json): 900 of 2,210 agree; 1,293 candidate-unknown records have no canceled debt and no screen answer (classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek recorded, project $0.00); 17 project-unknown are partial records withholding s1.cod_any, which every interview asks because the project's line reads it first (bases classm.f8889.2.deepseek, classm.f5695.3, classm.s1.3). No value differences. Project stands.
